data.name: Chaitra
data.gender_notes: Chaitra is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Caitra’, meaning ‘Spring’ or ‘Beginning’. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Chaitanya, representing the dawn and the beginning of new life. It is believed that the name Chaitra brings auspiciousness, prosperity, and new beginnings. The name Chaitra carries the meaning “Spring, Beginning, Dawn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chaitra usually hope their child will grow to embody spring, beginning, dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of renewal and the dawn of new beginnings.
data.etymology: Chaitra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spring, Beginning, Dawn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chaitra total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chaitra holds great significance in Hindu culture, particularly during the month of the same name in the Hindu calendar (March-April). During this time, various Hindu festivals such as Holi, Ram Navami, and Hanuman Jayanti are celebrated, marking the arrival of Spring and the renewal of life. The name is also used for naming children born during this auspicious month.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Chaitra is rooted in deep spiritual meaning. It is believed that invoking the name of Chaitanya, the goddess of most auspicious beginnings, brings blessings of prosperity, happiness, and new opportunities. The name is said to represent purity, growth, and the dawn of new hopes and dreams. In Hinduism, Chaitra symbolizes hope, renewal, and the beginning of a new journey towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chaitra represents the onset of new beginnings and the rejuvenating power of spring. Its vibrant energy symbolizes hope, joy, and the joyous celebration of life. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
